title: Pointed etale inverse-limit presentation of punctured root charts
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, f an element of R, n a natural number, and barY:Spec Omega -> Spec R a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] whose image is the point y. Let H be its canonical strict henselization ring [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] and b:R -> H the ring map whose spectrum is the structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. For any R-algebra S with structure map a, put A_S=S[T]/(T^n-a(f)), V_S=D(a(f)) inside Spec A_S, and k_S:V_S -> Spec R the composite of the open inclusion, the quotient-algebra structural map, and Spec(a) [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. There exist a small cofiltered category I [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a diagram D:I -> Scheme, a limiting cone c, and a natural transformation t:D -> const(Spec R), with every D(j) affine, and an isomorphism e:V_H -> c.pt such that e;pi_j;t_j=k_H for every j. For every j there exist an etale map a:R -> S [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point z of Spec S with Spec(a)(z)=y, and an isomorphism d:V_S -> D(j) satisfying d;t_j=k_S. This is asserted for arbitrary f and n, including n=0 and empty punctures.

proof.text: Apply pointed_etale_ring_colimit to obtain a small cofiltered ring diagram, its colimit presentation over H, and the etale maps and points over y. This step is completely proved in Lean.
Apply punctured_root_colimit_continuity to this ring colimit presentation and obtain the limiting affine root-chart cone and its compatible comparison isomorphisms.

For each j choose S=F(op j), a=a.app(op j), and the point supplied by the first step. Combine its etaleness and image equation with the stage isomorphism from the second step. The resulting tuple is exactly the original conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_root_limit_presentation
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : R) (n : ℕ)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    (y : Spec R) (hy : ∀ x : Spec (.of Ω), barY x = y)
    (b : R ⟶ strictHenselizationRing barY)
    (hb : Spec.map b = strictHenselizationStructuralMap barY) :
    let H := strictHenselizationRing barY
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∃ (I : Type u) (cat : Category.{u} I), letI := cat
      ∃ (_ : IsCofiltered I) (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
        (t : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj (Spec R)),
        Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ (∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j)) ∧
        ∃ e : V.toScheme ≅ c.pt,
          (∀ j, e.hom ≫ c.π.app j ≫ t.app j = V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b) ∧
          ∀ j, ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (a : R ⟶ S) (z : Spec S),
            Etale (Spec.map a) ∧ (Spec.map a) z = y ∧
            let g := a.hom f
            let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
            let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
            let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S A))
            let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap S A g)
            ∃ d : V.toScheme ≅ D.obj j,
              d.hom ≫ t.app j = V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map a
